collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager leaves a banana peel on the path as a friend rounds the corner: shout a warning, or dive for the peel.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) finishes a banana, looks around for somewhere to put the peel and, for one second only, sets it down on the path so (subject.he/she) can retie (subject.his/her) sandal. In that one second, (friend) comes round the corner carrying a big basket of clean washing, looking at the sky.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "PEEL!" shouts (subject). (friend) looks down, sees it, and steps neatly over it with a small, smug smile. Then (friend.he/she) walks straight into the curtain of wet vines hanging from the tree beside the path, which (friend.he/she) wasn't looking at. The washing stays perfectly dry. (friend) does not. "Thank you," (friend.he/she) says, dripping, "for the warning."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) lunges for the peel. (friend) swerves to avoid (subject). (subject) grabs the peel, slips on the wet grass anyway, and slides gently along on (subject.his/her) back with the peel held high in triumph. The washing lands on (subject.him/her) one piece at a time. "Did you get it?" asks (friend). "I got it," says (subject), from somewhere under a blanket.
